Questions

Frequently asked questions

What areas do you serve?

We work across Ouachita and Lincoln Parish in north Louisiana — Monroe, West Monroe, Ruston and the communities around them. If you’re on the edge of that, call and ask; we’ll tell you straight whether we can get to you. Full detail on our service area page.

Do I need to be home, or provide water and power?

Most jobs just need access to an outdoor water spigot and an outlet — we bring our own equipment. You don’t need to be home; just let us know how to get to the areas being cleaned.

Is pressure washing safe for my siding, roof, or paint?

Yes, when the right method is used. We soft wash delicate surfaces — low pressure plus a cleaning solution that kills the mildew and algae instead of blasting it off — and save high pressure for concrete, brick and stone.

How often should I get my house or driveway washed?

In Louisiana’s humidity most homes benefit from a wash once or twice a year to stay ahead of mildew, algae and pollen buildup. Shaded north-facing walls and concrete under trees usually need it more often than sun-exposed surfaces.

What does it cost?

Every property is different, so we give free, no-obligation estimates before any work starts. Call or text Jase or Garrett with a few photos or a description and we’ll get you a number fast.

Do you do commercial or rental properties?

Yes — the same washing, flowerbed and hauling work applies to rentals, small commercial buildings and turnover cleanups. Call or text and describe the property.
